author: Velkhana00
quote: The only positive quality about this game is the graphics which are dampened by the 30 fps. There’s really no excuse for a game with a budget this big in 2026 to be that way, and that doesn’t even compare to how abysmal the story and characters are. I thought the only saving grace would be the free roam but a lot of the things you liked about the previous games’ free roam is more restrictive. Definitely not worth the premium price you pay for it
